ACES adapts explicit participant-local access binding into stable keyed declarations with explicit VM and account references plus a closed SSH/RDP channel. It does not copy either syntax, infer a channel from OS family, represent an established simulator session, expose ports or locators, carry raw credentials, or claim that authored availability was realized.
